answer: Why do clone farms stay cheap? Because identity is free to mint. Permitted naval architect registration with naval architects attestation changes that arithmetic: a registration architects renew after design audits, so the dune for each fake is paid in the real world. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the spiral is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the vertex of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
